system.description:
| Virulent / [Physical], [Elemental] / Your body has been compromised by the Hebi’s Viper Blood. Good Luck. / A Virulent creature cannot regain hit or chakra points. / A Virulent creature cannot gain temporary hit points or chakra points. / A Virulent creature reduces its damage die size by 1 step. If they use a d4, it instead becomes 1 damage, per dice that would be rolled. / Creatures that are resistant or immune to poison damage or the Envenomed condition are resistant or immune to the Virulent condition. / A creature can spend its action to make a DC 15 Constitution check to remove this condition. |

1st Level Clan Feature

The Hebi are prolific in their ability with a blade. Master swordsmen, their style of fighting is akin to an aggressive serpent coiling into itself and striking forward with its fangs erect. You learn the Serpent’s Coil Bukijutsu stance. This stance can only be used with weapons from the Blade Weapon Group.

As part of entering this stance and at the beginning of each of your turns while in this stance, you can spend 1 Vipers Blood to infuse your weapon with concentrated venom for the next minute. While your weapon is infused and you are in this stance, [Weapon Damage] you deal becomes poison, and it gains a rank of Mastery to their damage rolls. This increases to 2 ranks at 11th level.

In place of an attack made as part of your Attack Action, you can instead make a Viper Strike or a Python Strike. Alternatively, by spending 1 Viper Blood, you can use a Strike ability as part of a Hebi Clan Hijutsu you cast., applying their saving throw on a successful hit or failed saving throw.

Hebi Clan Hijutsu, gain their Serpent Coil effects.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

Viper Strike. Once per turn, make a weapon attack, dealing your [Weapon Damage], ignoring temporary hit points a creature may have. By spending 2 Viper Blood as part of this attack, you force them to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they become Virulent until the beginning of your next turn. If an affected creature has ranks of Envenomed, you can choose to reduce those ranks to 0, and inflict Virulent, for the next minute. Your [Weapon Damage] dealt as part of this Viper Strike increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Python Strike. Once per turn, make a weapon attack, dealing your [Weapon Damage] If the target is currently Grappled, Restrained, or has their movement speed reduced by an effect you or an allied creature applied, this attack gains a +1 bonus to its critical threat range. On a critical hit, by spending 1 Viper Blood, this attack gains the Deadly 2 property. This increases to Deadly 3 at 7th level and Deadly 4 at 15th level.
